name: currency-exchange
title: Currency Exchange
description: Simple Currency Exchange with a selectable rate provider (ExchangeRate-API, UniRateAPI or keyless ECB rates via AllRatesToday)
author: xeric

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Rate Provider
preferences.description: Which exchange rate API to query. AllRatesToday needs no API key but covers only the ~30 currencies in the ECB daily reference table and has no historical rates.

preferences.name: api_key
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Key for the selected provider. ExchangeRate-API: https://app.exchangerate-api.com/dashboard — UniRateAPI: https://unirateapi.com/dashboard — not needed for AllRatesToday
preferences.placeholder: API key for the selected provider
